title: Orleans 2A | 30a Vacation Rental | 30a Beach Properties – 30A Beach Properties
meta_description: Close to shops and cafes with a 2 min walk to beach, Orleans 2A is a rental you don't want to miss! Click here to book a stay today.
description_expanded:
Orleans 2A features a designer kitchen with a spacious outdoor lounging balcony.

Newer build, this professionally designed sophisticated residence is located next to Rosemary Beach Town Hall, south of 30-A.

Set among some of Rosemary Beach's finest restaurants in the village of Rosemary Beach.

74 Town Hall Road, Unit 2A

Rosemary Beach, FL 32461

2 Kings | 2 Bunks | 3 Full Baths

Luxury fixtures and furnishings throughout blend to create the feel of a five star hotel suite.

Pool: Barbados Pool is 4 homes away.

Beach: Boardwalk G and H are a 2 min walk.

Parking: 1 Garage Parking Space, Fits Suv: Tahoe, X7, Expedition. Extended suvs will not fit. Passes for street parking additional cars provided.

Dining:

Ground floor: Wine Garden & Piano

Top Floor: Pescado Rooftop Fine Dining

South of 30-A and close to the Rosemary Beach Town Hall, this new family suite is steps to shops and cafes, and a 2 min walk to beach. The large outdoor balcony that overlooks Barrett Square acts as a second living area - great for dining or lounging. Fine finishes and Wolf & Subzero appliances. There are two master suites with ensuite baths featuring king beds and Waterworks bath fixtures. There are two built in alcove bunks in the hallway with their own full bath with shower. A large laundry room offers a nice touch. The Orleans bldg is the home of Pescado Rooftop Dining. Professionally decorated.
